label: Nightlife Venue
description: Where people go out: clubs, bars, stages and the rooms behind them. The library had twenty location sections a crew shoots at and none where more than one person is having a good time.

items.name: nightclub-floor
items.text: A packed nightclub floor under a low ceiling, a mirrorball throwing moving coins of light across raised arms, haze catching every beam.
items.text_short: packed nightclub floor under a mirrorball

items.name: disco-parquet
items.text: A gleaming lit-from-below disco parquet in coloured squares, chrome railings, a mirrorball turning slowly over an emptying floor.
items.text_short: lit disco parquet in coloured squares

items.name: dj-booth
items.text: A cramped DJ booth above the dance floor, decks and mixer glowing, a wall of monitors behind and reaching hands below the rail.
items.text_short: raised DJ booth over the dance floor

items.name: neon-cocktail-bar
items.text: A narrow cocktail bar in neon and dark lacquer, bottles backlit in rows, a bartender mid-pour and condensation on the counter.
items.text_short: neon cocktail bar, bottles backlit

items.name: dive-bar
items.text: A scuffed dive bar with a sticky counter, taped vinyl stools, a jukebox in the corner and beer signs buzzing on the wall.
items.text_short: scuffed dive bar with a jukebox

items.name: hotel-lounge-piano
items.text: A hushed hotel lounge in deep carpet and low lamps, a grand piano at the centre, cocktail glasses catching amber light.
items.text_short: hushed hotel piano lounge

items.name: speakeasy-backroom
items.text: A hidden speakeasy backroom behind an unmarked door, tin ceiling, candle jars on small tables and cigarette haze at head height.
items.text_short: hidden speakeasy backroom, candlelit

items.name: rooftop-party
items.text: A rooftop party strung with festoon bulbs, the city glittering beyond a low parapet, drinks on a ledge and a speaker stack humming.
items.text_short: rooftop party strung with festoon bulbs

items.name: house-party-kitchen
items.text: A house party spilling into the kitchen, bottles crowding the counter, someone sitting on the worktop and a speaker propped in the doorway.
items.text_short: house party spilling into the kitchen

items.name: concert-hall-stage
items.text: A concert hall from the pit, stage lights raking through haze, silhouetted heads in the foreground and a wall of amplifiers behind the band.
items.text_short: concert stage seen from the pit

items.name: festival-main-stage
items.text: A festival main stage across a field of raised hands, scaffolding towers, banners snapping and dust hanging in the beams.
items.text_short: festival main stage over a field of hands

items.name: backstage-corridor
items.text: A backstage corridor of flight cases and taped cable runs, a bare bulb over a mirror, set lists and passes stuck to a scuffed door.
items.text_short: backstage corridor of flight cases

items.name: karaoke-booth
items.text: A tiny private karaoke booth in padded vinyl, a screen glowing lyric blue, two microphones and a tray of half-finished drinks.
items.text_short: tiny padded karaoke booth, screen glowing

items.name: casino-floor
items.text: A casino floor of green baize and brass, chips stacked in careful towers, low warm downlights and no clock anywhere on the wall.
items.text_short: casino floor in green baize and brass

items.name: arcade-bar
items.text: An arcade bar washed in cabinet glow, rows of screens attracting in the dark, a pinball table flashing and a bar squeezed along one wall.
items.text_short: arcade bar washed in cabinet glow

items.name: pool-party
items.text: A pool party at the golden end of the day, water throwing caustics onto tiled edges, loungers scattered and a bar cart in the shade.
items.text_short: pool party, water throwing caustics

items.name: after-hours-diner
items.text: An all-night diner in the small hours, fluorescent glare on chrome and formica, one booth occupied and coffee going cold.
items.text_short: all-night diner in the small hours

items.name: club-smoking-terrace
items.text: A club's smoking terrace behind a fire door, breath and smoke in the cold, bass thudding through the wall and a queue along the rail.
items.text_short: club smoking terrace behind a fire door

items.name: burlesque-cabaret-room
items.text: A small cabaret room of round tables and red velvet, a shallow stage lit by footlights, tassels of a curtain still swinging.
items.text_short: red velvet cabaret room with footlights

items.name: warehouse-rave
items.text: A raw warehouse rave, strobes cutting through fog, steel columns and a stacked sound system, condensation running down bare brick.
items.text_short: raw warehouse rave, strobes through fog
